verdict.rationale: Lium documents a public platform API with a live OpenAPI 3.1 schema at lium.io/api/openapi.json, named endpoints such as POST /executors/rent-by-spec and POST /auth/signup, scoped API keys, and stable machine-readable error codes. It states an agent can do everything without a browser. The probe's 404s hit docs.lium.io paths, not the documented lium.io/api/openapi.json, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the documented OpenAPI endpoint and API work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Lium platform API publishes a live [OpenAPI 3.1](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.0) schema.
rent-by-spec (`POST /executors/rent-by-spec`) that rents the cheapest node matching a GPU spec under a `max_price_per_gpu_hour` ceiling
An agent can do everything on Lium with no browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods.
**`error.code`** is stable. Branch on it, not on the message.
